usage: Overlay tacz/ paths in the matching Release gunpack and mods/resources paths in the matching mod. This text source tree omits binary art/audio and generated native samples and cannot be installed by itself.
license_scope: Current mod metadata: MIT (arsenal code); GPL-3.0 (original ssjj_dark assets and skill code); artwork retains original rights. The verbatim inherited GPL notice is resources/META-INF/licenses/ssjj_dark/LICENSE. Root LICENSE is limited to original code/configuration; pre-existing third-party notices remain applicable. External Minecraft/Forge/TaCZ/ASM/Guava binaries and mappings are not included.
normalization: Only public version fields and explicitly listed host-specific provenance strings change. Original and public SHA256 values are recorded separately.
